label: Diagram 25
caption: Diagram 25 An example of a bathroom incorporating a corner WC
description: This is a plan view (top-down drawing) titled "Diagram 25 An example of a bathroom incorporating a corner WC". Along the left wall is a bath, with a hatched area at its head labelled "Bath transfer seat"; a "Towel rail" is fixed to the wall above it. A vertical dimension line on the left reads "2500mm", and a horizontal dimension line at the bottom reads "2700mm". In the centre, a dashed square containing a wheelchair symbol is labelled "1500mm x 1500mm Wheelchair turning space". On the bottom wall, a label reads "Two clothes hooks, at 1400mm and 1050mm above the floor". In the bottom-right corner sits a corner WC, with a small dimension "140–160mm" beside it; a wash basin with a tap is on the right wall above it. The top wall to the right carries a vertical grab rail and a curved dashed arc, with labels "Sanitary dispenser", "Disposal bin" and "Shelf". Two notes state: "The arrangement of the corner WC and ancillary fittings is as at Diagram 18" and "For the arrangement of the bath and ancillary fittings see ancillary Diagram 26". A footnote reads "Note Layout shown for right-hand transfer to bath and WC".
